doc: Walks the global singly-linked list headed by D_80081498 looking for every node whose field_10 (offset 0x10) equals the argument; for each match, sets bit 0x8000 in that node's field_1E (offset 0x1E) AND in the global 32-bit flags word D_800814A0. There is no early exit -- the entire list is always walked even after a match is found.
